fit_reference: Fit on all optimizer input/target pairs from the actual two rank-local train loaders, including train BOS outcomes. Unigram probabilities are (N_y+0.5)/(N+0.5*V). Bigram probabilities are (N_xy+p_unigram(y))/(N_x+1). Evaluate only positive-byte targets and divide total bits by the original token byte lengths. Validation pairs select sparse sufficient-statistic storage only; all training windows and denominators are counted.
input_selection: BPB second 1,048,576 target window after the standalone scorer consumes its first 1,048,576 targets for token CE/PPL/ECE.
